name: Forever My Love - Kimi o Wasurenai
original_name: Forever My Love・君を忘れない
source:
Hero had a dream of studying abroad in an international academy, and now his dream comes true. Meet your new acquaintances and use card conversation system for communication.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄有一个到国际学院留学的梦想，现在他的梦想实现了。结识新朋友并使用卡片对话系统进行交流。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
